imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The kettlebell guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap showed 26 discovered URLs and zero indexed URLs in the report snapshot.
searchConsole.decision: The queryless homepage sample is too small to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore strengthens crawl paths and topic clusters with one authority expansion plus two unrelated evergreen explorations.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or another variation on an existing topic.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the kettlebell guide. The travel-security and wedding-band guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy public-Wi-Fi and travel-device handoff that reconciles current HTTPS protections with network verification, account hardening, update, loss-response and recovery controls in one printable record.
authority.cluster: Travel and digital-resilience authority, with reciprocal paths from home Wi-Fi security, digital-account recovery, carry-on packing and hotel-arrival guides; the kettlebell and wedding-band pages also strengthen home-training and durable-personal-style clusters.
authority.opportunity: One qualified factual-review opportunity was logged for CISA Secure Our World through the agency's official contact route; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions in Life, Fitness and Style: how to connect and recover while traveling, how to choose one strength tool by fit and space, and how to buy a daily-wear ring by geometry and material. Only the equipment guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
